review_complete_scope: Bounded alternatives comparison with actual manufacturer leads, geometric speed/torque reconciliation and explicit energy interfaces.
development_recommendation: Continue Kubota/Danfoss hydrostatic as lead, conditional on the existing drive/brake/OEM evidence gates. Retain diesel-electric as a serious alternative and diesel-mechanical/torque-converter as a comparison. No evidence supports changing the owner's brake requirements or claiming a construction-ready locomotive.

routes.advantage: Existing traceable low-speed/ratio candidate and controllable reversing architecture.
routes.governing_evidence: OEM continuous engine and hydraulic maps, low-speed behavior, input torsion, custom reduction/axle support and cooling. All3N.1/2 holds remain.

routes.real_lead: Carraro TCB80 family documented in manufacturer construction table; not a selected transmission
routes.advantage: Potentially simpler efficient locked mechanical power path; actual launch/converter and reverse architecture needed.
routes.governing_evidence: Exact model, input speed/torque limits, converter stall/torque ratio/efficiency, creep heat, forward/reverse gear ratios, Kubota housing/coupling, controls and rail duty. Engine-power application band is not a train-force or towing rating.

routes.real_lead: Parker GVM210-100-SPW historical reference at320V; current GVM/GVI families listed
routes.advantage: Potential flexible electrical placement and controlled individual axle torque, without main traction hydraulic plumbing.
routes.governing_evidence: Current exact motor winding/order, matched inverter, generator/rectifier, DC regulation and energy sink, operating maps and cooling. Historical rating is not current availability or a rail selection.

common_custom_scope: Custom locomotive frame, suspension and axleboxes
Movement-compatible torque reaction, joints and guards
Engine cooling/exhaust enclosure, fuel installation, visibility and service access
electric_extra_interfaces: Generator torsional coupling, net output map and engine controls
Rectifier/DC bus regulation, precharge, contactors, fusing, isolation/ground-fault strategy and high-voltage interlocks
Matched motor/inverter current, speed, resolver/encoder, thermal and torque limits
Battery or braking chopper/resistor energy path for regeneration; no assumption diesel generator absorbs braking energy
Separate hotel-power load/supply coordination; no counting the same generator capacity twice
Defined safe coast/stop behavior after bus/inverter faults and independent air-brake application
fabrication_boundary: No additional locomotive holes, plates, gear teeth, welds or mounts are established. These alternatives cannot share a generic9:1 gearbox or the same support drawing.
